# SignalForge
Project: https://github.com/maumoya/SignalForge
Author: Mauricio Moya
Status: v0.2.0, first signed release
Tagline: Spot the signal. Build what matters.
Purpose: Offline video analytics, same-creator outlier multipliers, pre-registered title and hook rule tests across creators, opt-in public GitHub repo discovery and read-only research leads.
Skill: https://github.com/maumoya/SignalForge/blob/main/skills/signalforge/SKILL.md
Install: /plugin marketplace add maumoya/SignalForge ; /plugin install signalforge@signalforge
Alternative: npx skills add maumoya/SignalForge
Safety: Offline video CLI; explicit public GitHub API query only for opt-in discovery; no installs or auto-adoption.
Evidence: 43/43 synthetic Python unit tests (2026-11-10).
Study protocol: https://github.com/maumoya/SignalForge/blob/main/skills/signalforge/references/study-protocol.md
